title: Inter-variant runtime parity maintenance for tokenizer, context, and tooling
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Background: Smart routing can route requests by region, customer tier, or latency SLO and may fall back to model variants when the chosen variant is unavailable. Past incidents showed subtle incompatibilities between variants: mismatched tokenizers, differing max context handling, and ops tooling mismatches (e.g., KV cache layout and runtime flags). This ticket centralizes a recurring maintenance sweep to keep the inter-variant compatibility matrix authoritative and automated so routing fallbacks remain safe.

Scope:
- Audit tokenizer tokenization parity and edge-case token mappings for top 30 active variants (hosted + dedicated + private).
- Verify max_context and context handling invariants (truncation / sliding window semantics) are consistent across fallback candidates.
- Ensure runtime tooling parity: KV cache key formats, prefix cache behavior, and model-serving flags used by the runtime are compatible or properly translated by our fallback shim.
- Expand telemetry and alerts to detect mismatch regressions during canary and rollout.

Non-goals: full model weight alignment, training-time changes, or exhaustive tests across all community models (we focus on variants we serve or route to).
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility matrix updated and published for the top-30 active variants with tokenizer and context columns populated
Automated parity checks (tokenizer smoke, context-length simulation, KV key roundtrip) run in CI for any change to a variant definition
Routing layer has a gating rule to prevent falling back to a variant with known incompatibility for that customer route
Dashboard shows parity telemetry and fires a regression alert when a production mismatch rate exceeds 0.1% for 10m
tasks: Inventory current top-30 variants and existing matrix entries (owner: Miguel)
Write tokenizer smoke tests (edge cases, special unicode, control tokens) and add to variant CI (owner: Claire Nguyen)
Create context-handling simulator to replay 3 representative prefix shapes and verify KV cache behavior across variants (owner: Sanjay Patel)
Implement fallback-gating policy in routing config and feature flag for gradual rollout (owner: Platform Routing team)
Add telemetry tags for variant-pair mismatches and surface in Console (owner: Observability)
Automate nightly matrix reconciliation job and report (owner: SRE)
Run targeted canary across two regions and two tiers, capture mismatch metrics and validate rollback behavior
telemetry_checks: Measure tokenization divergence rate by sample prompt set (daily)
Track truncated-response incidence correlated with context-length differences (5m resolution)
KV cache miss/invalidation spikes when routing falls back (alert threshold 0.05% per minute)
End-to-end functional failures vs. model-pair (classification of failure causes)
automation_plan: Add CI job variant-parity-smoke that runs tokenizer and context sims on PRs to model metadata
Nightly job: reconcile matrix.json against served variants, open auto-issues for unknown gaps
Routing preflight: before enabling variant in a route, run a lightweight compatibility probe against a canary cluster
On-detect: auto-disable fallback for affected route and create a PagerDuty alert linking to playbook
